headline: TJX closed FY26 with a 5% holiday-quarter comp and 9% sales growth, topping estimates; guided FY27 comps +2-3%.
guidance_note: FY27 guide: comp +2-3%, pretax margin 11.7-11.8%, EPS $4.93-5.02. Q1 comp +2-3%, EPS $0.97-0.99.
key_messages: Consolidated comp +5% and Marmaxx US comp +5%; comp driven by higher basket (larger driver) and more transactions.
Transactions rose in every division except HomeGoods, where they were essentially flat.
Adjusted gross margin +60 bps to 31.1% on merchandise margin and shrink back at pre-COVID levels.
Herrman: customer value perception improved over the last six months; new shoppers attracted in every country.
Annual sales topped $60bn; management monitoring changing tariffs and expects episodic vendor pricing responses.

consumer.pricing: Tariffs monitored; no negative customer reaction to pricing, and value perception improved per surveys.

macro_read: Solid holiday-quarter results with rising transactions show value-focused shoppers kept spending, though FY27 guidance assumed a slower 2-3% comp pace.

sources.label: Motley Fool Q4 FY26 call transcript
